notes: NMEA's All-State ensembles happen in November at the NMEA Conference/Clinic, so the November 2026 events are the 2026-27 season and NMEA labels them '2026'. NMEA had fully published 2026 repertoire, conductors, audition materials, dates, and fees at the time of retrieval. Two choral programs are captured: the high school All-State Chorus and the All-State Middle Level Chorus (held on even years only). NMEA also lists an All-State Children's Choir (grades 4-5, odd years only) and an All-State Orff Ensemble (even years) — the Children's Choir is not running in 2026 and was not captured. NMEA notes future All-State dates 'may shift depending on the finalized Husker football schedules.'

organization.name: Nebraska Music Education Association
organization.description: NMEA is the Nebraska federated state association of NAfME. Annually it provides all-state honor ensemble opportunities for high school students in grades 9-12 (band, chorus, jazz band, orchestra), plus alternating-year honor ensembles for elementary (grades 4-5) and middle school students. All-State rehearsals and performances take place during the NMEA Conference/Clinic, with performances at the Lied Center for Performing Arts in Lincoln.

programs.name: 2026 Nebraska All-State Chorus
programs.description: NMEA's high school all-state honor chorus for students in grades 9-12 whose teachers are NMEA members. Auditions are submitted online through Festival Scores. Rehearsals are held on Days 1 and 2 and the morning of Day 3 of the NMEA Conference/Clinic, with performances at the Lied Center for Performing Arts in Lincoln, Nebraska on the afternoon and evening of Day 3. 2026 conductor: Dr. Marques L. A. Garrett, Associate Professor of Choral Studies at the University of North Texas.

dates.title: Choral audition upload window
dates.description: Website portal opens and closes for choral audition uploads. Audition excerpts are announced via email September 24 at 8:00 AM CST. $25 fee per audition. The Auditions Chair is only available for support from 8 am - 10 pm CST.

dates.title: NMEA Conference / All-State rehearsals and concerts
dates.description: Wednesday-Friday, November 18-20, 2026. Rehearsals on Days 1 and 2 and the morning of Day 3; performances at the Lied Center for Performing Arts, Lincoln, NE on the afternoon and evening of Day 3. NMEA notes dates may shift depending on the finalized Husker football schedules.

requirements.title: Grades 9-12, teacher must be an NMEA member
requirements.description: The All-State high school ensembles are for students in grades 9-12. Students of NMEA members are encouraged to audition.

requirements.title: Audition submitted through Festival Scores
requirements.description: NMEA uses the services of Festival Scores to collect student auditions. The audition consists of scales, arpeggios, and excerpts from the All-State Chorus music (made available on the NMEA website when the chorus audition window opens on Festival Scores). Excerpts are announced by email on September 24 at 8:00 AM CST, the same morning the upload portal opens.

requirements.title: All-State scales
requirements.description: Scales are performed without accompaniment; only the tonic pitch is sounded, four times in tempo. Soprano and Tenor sing F major ascending and descending one time only a cappella. Alto and Bass sing B-flat major ascending and descending one time only a cappella.

requirements.title: All-State arpeggios
requirements.description: Arpeggios are performed with chordal accompaniment only. The tonic pitch is sounded four times in tempo. Practice tracks for scales and arpeggios are provided for Soprano/Tenor and Alto/Bass.

requirements.title: Rehearsal tracks are per-student purchases
requirements.description: The 2026 Nebraska All-State Chorus rehearsal track package is purchased and downloaded per student. NMEA asks teachers on the honor system not to purchase a set (one of each voice part) and distribute it to multiple students, and asks individual purchasers not to share their MP3s.

repertoire.title: All Night I Could Not Sleep
An Earth Song
repertoire.notes: Composer name as published by NMEA.

fees.description: $25 fee per audition; due by October 12 at 11:59 PM CST.

documents.title: 2026 Nebraska All-State Choir Conductor Notes (Dr. Marques L. A. Garrett)

programs.name: 2026 All-State Middle Level Chorus
programs.description: A one-day honor chorus for students in sixth through eighth grades whose teachers are NMEA members, offered during even-numbered years at the NMEA Conference/Clinic, with the final performance on the Lied Center for Performing Arts main stage. 2026 conductor: Dr. Derrick Fox, Michigan State University.

dates.title: Choral audition upload window
dates.description: Website portal opens September 9 and closes September 21 at 11:59 PM CST. $10 fee per audition. The Auditions Chair is only available for support from 8 am - 10 pm CST.

dates.title: 2026 All-State Middle Level Chorus
dates.description: Wednesday, November 18, 2026. One-day event with the final performance on the Lied Center for Performing Arts main stage.

requirements.title: Who can attend
requirements.description: Students must be registered at and attending the school or home school listed on the registration; must be under the direction of an NMEA member; must be in sixth through eighth grade during the 2026-2027 school year; and the director MUST be registered for and attend the Conference with their student(s).

requirements.title: Audition components
requirements.description: Auditions are collected through Festival Scores and include a scale, an excerpt of either 'My Country Tis of Thee' or 'We Shall Overcome', and a solo excerpt.

requirements.title: Scale
requirements.description: Students sing a scale a cappella in the key of their choosing on solfege or monosyllables. Teachers may give students their starting pitch.

requirements.title: Prepared excerpt
requirements.description: Students sing 'My Country Tis of Thee' or 'We Shall Overcome' a cappella. Teachers may give students their starting pitch in the same key as their scale. If a student is unable to sing either of these songs for personal reasons, NMEA directs the teacher to contact Stacy Bean at middle.level@nmeanebraska.org.

requirements.title: Solo excerpt
requirements.description: The solo chosen by the student and/or director should reflect the voice part for which the student is auditioning and must be 40-60 seconds in length. It may be a prepared solo or an excerpt from prepared choral literature.

repertoire.title: My Country Tis of Thee
repertoire.notes: One of two prepared audition excerpt options; no composer published by NMEA.

repertoire.title: We Shall Overcome
repertoire.notes: One of two prepared audition excerpt options; no composer published by NMEA.

fees.description: $10.00 audition fee for all students who audition; invoiced through Festival Scores. Due October 5 at 11:59 PM CST.
$50.00 participation fee for selected students; invoiced through Festival Scores. Due November 2, 2026.
